name: Saint Maria Goretti
history: An Italian farm girl of eleven who was stabbed by a young neighbour when she resisted his attempt to assault her. Before she died the next day she forgave him and said she wanted him with her in heaven. Years later he repented and asked her mother’s forgiveness. Pius XII canonised her in 1950, before the largest crowd ever gathered for a canonisation.
life: Maria was born at Corinaldo, near Ancona, to a poor farming family. Seeking work, they moved to the marshes near Nettuno, south of Rome, sharing a farmhouse with the Serenelli family. Her father died of malaria in 1900, and while her mother worked the fields, Maria kept house and cared for the younger children. She had little schooling but loved her faith, and made her first Communion not long before she died. On 5 July that year Alessandro Serenelli, aged twenty, tried to force himself on her, and when she refused, saying it was a sin, he stabbed her many times. She died in hospital the next day, having forgiven him. Alessandro was sentenced to thirty years. In prison he dreamed of Maria offering him lilies, and his heart changed. On his release he asked her mother’s forgiveness and received it, and he spent the rest of his life working for Capuchin friars.
prayerTo: Saint Maria Goretti, you were young and poor and you chose to suffer rather than sin, and you forgave the one who killed you. Pray for children and for all who suffer violence, for the healing of those who have been harmed, and for the conversion of those who do harm. Teach me to forgive. Amen.
penance: Pray for victims of abuse and violence today, and support a charity that protects children. Bring before God someone you find hard to forgive.
meditation: She wanted the man who killed her to be with her in heaven. Is there anyone you would rather not meet there?
